verdict.rationale: Groq is an LLM inference API platform, and a separate test or sandbox environment (test-mode keys, isolated projects) is a fair capability for an API platform to offer, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no sandbox or test environment isolated from production. Spend limits and the model's built-in code execution are adjacent features and do not deliver an isolated testing environment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
